name: pure-governance-evaluation
requirements: Capability, consent, policy-adoption, lifecycle-authority, policy-authority, and lifecycle-transition checks do not append relational events.
A governance decision may be appended explicitly as a GovernanceEvaluated event.
Governed operations such as runtime invocation may explicitly record the decisions they rely upon.
forbidden: A read-only authorization check mutating relationship history as an implicit side effect.
Loss of governance auditability when an operation intentionally records a decision.
